contract.input: Python str containing Unicode scalar values only
contract.output: One ordinary quoted Lean string literal whose exported kernel Expr is exactly {lit:{str:input}}
contract.invalid_input: Reject every UTF-16 surrogate code point U+D800..U+DFFF with SourceError, including adjacent surrogate pairs; do not replace or normalize text
rendering: Keep U+0020..U+007E except quotation mark and backslash byte-for-byte
Escape quotation mark as backslash quotation mark and backslash as doubled backslash
Use backslash n, backslash r, and backslash t for their respective controls
Use exactly two lowercase hexadecimal digits after backslash x for remaining U+0000..U+001F and U+007F..U+009F
Use exactly four lowercase hexadecimal digits after backslash u for U+00A0..U+FFFF excluding surrogates
Emit U+10000..U+10FFFF directly as UTF-8 scalars
contract.unchanged_domains: No source parser, DSL grammar, scalar String domain, evaluator, native model, theorem imports, axioms, proof strategies, or policy budgets are modified

claims.statement: For every expanded positive fixture, both shared Printers and all three lean_string aliases render identical bytes; a fresh Lean definition compiled from those bytes kernel-replays as a safe String definition with value Expr exactly equal to the original string-literal Expr
claims.pass: all fixture rows map uniquely to exported safe definitions with exact type/value and empty axioms; imports and replay succeed; no sorries/warnings/errors
claims.block: any mismatch, missing/ambiguous declaration, invalid dependency, compile or replay failure

claims.statement: Empty text, every formerly accepted ASCII character, and their ordered concatenation retain the exact former quoted bytes
claims.pass: every finite legacy row equals quotation mark + original text + quotation mark

claims.statement: All frozen invalid surrogate inputs are rejected by the helper, its aliases and shared Printers
claims.pass: every invalid fixture raises SourceError before UTF-8 source emission

claims.statement: Pinned Lean rejects every frozen malformed-escape declaration and the deliberately unequal literal theorem proved with rfl
claims.pass: each negative compile has nonzero actual compiler return code, at least one error, no timeout, no successful artifact and no sorry

claims.statement: Two isolated fresh build rounds of every frozen positive batch module have identical module-part hashes and replayed declaration inventories, exact correspondence and provenance
claims.pass: both clean build rounds pass every batch, expected artifacts and normalized replay inventories agree, manifest inputs remain unchanged
claims.block: input mutation, build failure, mismatch or undeclared nondeterminism
